title: The Last Caravan
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.The caravans stopped coming to Ashreach. Tomas Reeve wants to know what happened to the last one, which a sandstorm buried at the west end of the Dune Sea.

About

Given byTomas Reeve
Level38
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Caravan Ledger ×1
  • Caravan Cargo Bundle ×3

Steps

  1. Talk to Tomas Reeve (outdoors near Ashreach) to get the quest.
  2. Talk to Cole Hadley at 1809, 80
  3. Kill 15 siroccos (15)
  4. Talk to Cole Hadley at 1809, 80
  5. Kill 15 siroccos (15)
  6. Kill the Howling Sirocco at 1803, 668
    Bring Tomas Reeve the caravan master's ledger - Caravan Ledger at 1842, 87
    Bring Tomas Reeve 3 cargo bundles (3) - Caravan Cargo Bundle at 1842, 87

Rewards

Reward
Quest points1

What Tomas Reeve says

Cole Hadley: Tomas sent you. He's wanted to ask me himself all season.

Cole Hadley: I saw lanterns on the Dune Sea that night, a long way southwest. A caravan, driving hard to beat the storm.

Cole Hadley: It wasn't coming here. The lanterns turned southwest under the ridge, away from Ashreach. Then the storm came over them and I lost them.

Cole Hadley: The wreck is still down there at the west end of the Dune Sea, and siroccos blow around it now. If Kerr kept a ledger, it's in that wagon.

Tomas Reeve: That's Kerr's cloth. I'd know the weave anywhere. And his ledger. Let me see the last page.

Tomas Reeve: He sold the whole load before he ever set out, paid in full by a Thak quartermaster. Delivery to the vanguard camp on the Dune Sea.

Tomas Reeve: So the Thak bought the route. The caravans stopped coming north because they were all going to the Thak, and Kerr was driving to them when the storm caught him.

Tomas Reeve: I'll send the ledger to Sergeant Hallam at the post. She should know who is feeding that camp.

Tomas Reeve: Take this. It's more than the stall has made all season.

Handing it in

"Take this. It's more than the stall has made all season."
